m_responded = df[(df['sex'] == 'M') & (df['responded'] == 1)].shape[0]
m_total = df[df['sex'] == 'M'].shape[0]

print(f"Females: {f_responded}/{f_total} responded ({f_responded/f_total:.4f})")
print(f"Males: {m_responded}/{m_total} responded ({m_responded/m_total:.4f})")"}
